Feb 2025 – present

Speed Factory / Formula FARA

Freelance Motorsport Mechanic

Atlanta Motorsports Park

Driver Axle Robards

Situation
An on-track incident left the car with a damaged steering link and upper rear wishbone.
Task
Replace steering link & upper rear wishbone and ensure other bolts don't come loose.
Action
I fit in the spare parts we had and checked each bolt to confirm tightness, making this my first ever unassisted repair.
Result
The steering and rear suspension were repaired, and the bolt check made certain nothing else had come loose.

Sebring International Raceway

Driver Max Mokarem

Situation
The car developed a starter motor malfunction and had to be replaced.
Task
Disassemble surrounding systems to access the starter motor and replace it with a new one.
Action
I assisted my #1 mechanic in carrying out the repair process.
Result
The starter motor was renewed and the car was back in service, no longer needing an external starter.

May 2, 2025

Red Bull Formula 4 Driver Seat Event

Trackside Mechanic / Driver Coordinator, during the 2025 F1 Miami Grand Prix weekend

Homestead-Miami Speedway

Situation
Red Bull hosted an event known as "Miami Driver Seat" during the 2025 F1 Miami Grand Prix, giving VIP guests and influencers the chance to drive Formula 4 cars and participate in other activities.
Task
Fit guests into the car and teach them how to operate the vehicle while managing tight back-to-back driver rotations and performing rapid pit lane maintenance checks.
Action
I fit and taught over 20 drivers so that they may safely operate the Formula 4 car while swiftly checking the tires, bolts, and general cleanliness.
Result
Driver rotations ran safely and on schedule, and the cars stayed ready and reliable through each session.

Feb 2024 – Jan 2025

Isambard Performance Motorsports (IPM)

Kart Mechanic

Situation
Worked as a kart mechanic for both track days and race weekends at AMR Homestead-Miami Motorplex.
Task
Perform general maintenance and setup adjustments by analyzing driver telemetry accordingly to be successful and achieve fast lap times.
Action
I handled general maintenance (such as tire pressures, fuel loading, cleaning, and repair) while also communicating with drivers about their data and how they could improve.
Result
Track days and race weekends were successfully completed over the course of a year with addition of winning podium trophies.

KA100 Engine Teardown

Lower rod bearing failure on a karting engine

Problem
A trackday-only KA100 engine with about 50 hours of track time suffered a lubrication failure of the lower rod bearing and overheated.
Opportunity
Disassemble the engine and gain access to the broken & damaged components.
Solution
Expose the interior of the engine and assess which components must be repaired or replaced. The strongest damage includes:
  1. 1The piston skirt had cracked from the heat and pressure.
  2. 2A blue and orange hue had climbed upward from the crank.
  3. 3Black carbonization had formed on the connecting rod from the intense heat.
Outcome
The damaged parts were later replaced, and the engine went back into service.
